title: Beast of Reincarnation Game Reveals Voice Cast
content: GAME FREAK ( Pokémon ) unveiled in a developer interview during the "PC Gaming Show 2026" livestream on Sunday the voice cast for its Beast of Reincarnation game . Other cast members include Miyuki Satou , Akio Ōtsuka , Sumire Morohoshi , Yū Kobayashi , Akira Ishida , Satoshi Mikami , Rina Satō h and Tetsuo Kanao .

title: Drecom, Manga Box Launch New Label with 4 Titles
content: Japanese video game developer Drecom announced on Saturday that it is partnering with manga platform Manga Box to launch a new manga label called "Dre Box," which will focus on fantasy and isekai titles. The label will adapt Drecom 's original novels into manga to expand into the digital manga market for the company.

title: The Arena Studio to Develop Adaptations of Fatal Fury, The Art of Fighting Games
content: Entertainment news website The Hollywood Reporter reported on Friday that The Arena production studio (formerly known as Arena SNK ) is developing the "South Town Saga," a series of media adaptations based on SNK 's Fatal Fury and The Art of Fighting game franchises.
